https://athens-times.com/romanian-f-16-s.text: Romanian F-16 Shoots Down Drone for Third Consecutive Day Jul 26, 2026 — in World Athens Times Newsroom A Romanian Air Force F-16 fighter jet shot down another drone on Wednesday—the third in as many days—after it violated Romanian airspace. According to Romania’s Ministry of Defence, the drone was ‘safely intercepted’ 12 kilometres northeast of Sulina, within the country’s national airspace and over its territorial waters. Drone Traced to Russia The first drone, downed by the NATO member on Friday, was identified by Romanian prosecutors examining the wreckage as a Russian-made Shahed-type UAV. Authorities confirmed the origin following forensic analysis of the debris. Diplomatic Protest Announced In a firm statement posted on X, Romanian President Klaus Iohannis announced that Bucharest will deliver a formal diplomatic protest to the Russian Federation, based on findings from the ongoing investigation.

https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live.text: The US Department of Transportation opened an inquiry on Thursday into Tesla’s new CyberCab, the company’s latest take on a self-piloting robotaxi. The service debuted this week in Austin, Texas. Tesla’s founder, Elon Musk, billed it as “the future of transportation” in a post to social media. Just one problem, according to the Department of Transportation: Tesla informed regulators that the vehicles were compliant with the agency’s Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards. But the CyberCab lacks some crucial components, namely “conventional manual controls, such as a brake pedal, gas pedal, steering wheel, and mirrors,” which would typically be necessary to meet those criteria, according to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
